title: Choose the visual world for Reconciliation Copilot
question: The roll assigned Central Bank Statistical Bulletin. Keep it, pick an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Central Bank Statistical Bulletin
options.thesis: A stark typographic publication where every verification claim is proved inline by exposed three-leg settlement tables.
options.viewport: Masthead thesis bar with live batch controls, four double-ruled verification counters, and an exposed three-leg exception ledger.
options.risk: Feels austere if hierarchy relies on rules without sharp status contrast.

raised.raise: Ground-truth answer-key noise terrain stays visible beneath every row so false LLM matches surface immediately.
Every batch and transaction carries a canonical reference code with a 7-hue noise-category strip decoded inline.
All seven synthetic noise categories sit in a fixed ranked roster with exact survival and exception counts.

options.label: Chartered Accountant Trial Balance
options.lineage: Indian Chartered Accountant trial balance sheets & stamped voucher books
options.thesis: A ruled cotton-paper trial balance where deterministic matches post in cobalt ink and gated exceptions get vermilion stamps.
options.viewport: Ruled voucher header with batch runner, four balanced T-account summary columns, and a red-ink exception docket queue.
options.risk: Also the familiar accounting-ledger territory most financial audit tools land on.

options.label: Voucher Pass & Live Gate Board
options.lineage: Segmented travel boarding passes & live departure gate boards
options.thesis: Pairs a three-stub transaction pass (Ledger | Gateway | Bank) with a live board that reranks and latches exceptions in place.
options.viewport: Pinned 3-stub transaction inspector at top above a live-reranking settlement board holding escalated and gated rows lit.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: the three settlement sources map directly to a three-segment pass while unresolved rows hold their alert latch.
options.risk: Can read like transit ops if INR currency and UTR typography are not foregrounded.

options.label: Monochrome Claim & Live Proof
options.thesis: Near-black on near-white with a single signal accent reserved strictly for the 0.70 confidence gate, pairing each claim with live proof.
options.viewport: Two-column claim-and-proof header where the verification thesis sits beside the live batch trigger and gated exception table.
options.case: Excels for academic evaluators: every architectural assertion is immediately paired with the live verification artifact proving it.
options.risk: Single-accent restraint requires razor-sharp typographic contrast to distinguish deterministic vs. LLM rows.

options.label: Live Confidence Axis Specimen
options.thesis: A giant live 0.70 confidence gate slider and tolerance ruler that re-partitions the 300-row settlement grid in real time as you drag.
options.viewport: Enormous live verified-match readout and interactive 0.70 confidence gate scrubber above a 300-cell transaction matrix.
options.case: Turns the hard confidence gate from a backend config constant into a tactile, inspectable physical instrument.
options.risk: The axis scrubber must clearly separate read-only audit truth from interactive threshold simulation.

options.label: ISO Orienteering Contour Map
options.lineage: ISOM orienteering course maps & control tables
options.thesis: Fixed ground-truth noise contours beneath a purple verification course trace connecting each transaction control point.
options.viewport: Fixed noise-terrain map with a numbered verification route overlay and coded control punch table.
options.case: Fuses poorly: topographic forest contours obscure dense tabular INR settlement figures.
options.risk: Spatial map metaphors slow down rapid row-by-row accounting inspection.
options.kept: Ground-truth answer-key noise terrain stays locked beneath live reconciliation results.

options.label: Factory Catalog Coded Index
options.lineage: Factory Records FAC catalog & colour-coded sleeves
options.thesis: Matte-black catalog index where every batch and row is addressed by FAC serial number and a 7-color noise-code bar.
options.viewport: Serial-numbered batch header with a stacked variance plot and colour-coded transaction index.
options.case: Fuses poorly: replacing plain-English failure reasons with colour codes slows down finance controllers.
options.risk: Cryptic encoding works against immediate audit transparency.
options.kept: Canonical reference serials and a compact 7-hue noise-category strip decoded inline.

options.label: Ranked Exception Archetype Roster
options.thesis: A finite ranked roster of the seven synthetic noise archetypes, each with its own badge, survival rate, and failure note.
options.viewport: Seven ranked noise-archetype cards above a filtered transaction roster.
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful mascot-catalog conventions undercut institutional financial trust.
options.risk: Reads too lighthearted for an audit controller workbench.
options.kept: A finite ranked 7-card noise-category roster where each failure type keeps fixed summary furniture.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Modern SaaS fintech dashboard with clean slate cards, emerald/amber/red status pills, and a tabbed transaction table.
canonCard.viewport: Top navbar, 4-metric KPI row, noise breakdown bar, and a filterable reconciliation table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from standard fintech admin templates by design.
